info.title: foo-studio API
info.description:
Client portal contract (FS-85). JSON in and out, camelCase, UTC ISO times.

- Auth: `Authorization: Bearer <access token>` from the auth service. The workspace always comes from the token’s client_id, never from the URL or body.
- Errors: `{ code, message, details? }`; see the `Error_*` schemas.
- Lists: `?cursor=…&limit=20`, reply has `nextCursor`.
- Any POST that spends credits, publishes or grants needs an `Idempotency-Key` header.

kind.description: hero, text, gallery, menu, contact, map, …

bytes.description: At most 5 MB; at most 5 images per request

free.description: monthly.free + topup.free; held credits are already taken out
monthly.free + topup.free; held credits are already taken out

cost.description: 15 once the draft has started, else 0

focus.description: The one thing to do next; null when nothing is waiting

id.description: The ledger row id, or held:<requestId> for a hold

credits.description: Signed: + adds, − spends; a hold shows the amount set aside

message.content: Got it. Hours on Home and Visit us both change.

replyBy.description: Set while it is the client’s turn
Set while it is the client’s turn

nextStep.description: Shown on every closed or held request

reference.description: Put this in the transfer note
